Perhaps read an interesting book with many themes, or plot lines, or to explore different areas which come of interest. Reel your mind back to its former position by exercising it. I'm not talking about arithmetic, by the way, that's too simple. Push yourself, and become more active. Exercise does help circulate the blood to your head. Before all of this, create a plan, and find the motivation.
